اعتمدتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَدْتُنَّ (iʕtamadtunna) /iʕ.ta.mad.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اُعْتُمِدْتُنَّ (uʕtumidtunna) /uʕ.tu.mid.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
